fix: REMOVE unit_modulus -DEPENDS_ON-> fhrr_bind; REMOVE unit_modulus -DEPENDS_ON-> fhrr_unbind (the correct edges are fhrr_bind/unbind -USES-> unit_modulus; verify present)

fix: REMOVE probability_distribution -DEPENDS_ON-> shannon_entropy (breaks 2-cycle; keep shannon_entropy USES probability_distribution); REMOVE probability_distribution -DEPENDS_ON-> weak_supervision
